parameters.Q: <int> Number of treatment requests to be scheduled.
parameters.T: <int> Number of time periods in the planning horizon.
parameters.N: <int> Average number of treatments per request.
parameters.U: <int> Average number of treatments that can be handled per bin per time period.
parameters.W: <int> Maximum total weight that each bin can hold in any time period.
parameters.L: <str> Maximum number of bins available per time period ('infinity' if unrestricted).

num_real_items: <int> Total number of treatment items to be scheduled (excluding source and sink).
num_total_items: <int> Total number of items including the source and sink auxiliary items.
source_item_id: <int> Identifier of the auxiliary source item fixed at time zero.
sink_item_id: <int> Identifier of the auxiliary sink item fixed at time T plus one.

items.weight: <int> Weight of this item that consumes bin capacity when assigned.
items.type: <str> Role of this item: 'treatment' for a real schedulable item, 'source' or 'sink' for auxiliary timing anchors.
items.request_id: <int> Identifier of the treatment request this item belongs to (treatment items only).
items.treatment_index: <int> Position of this treatment within its request's ordered sequence (treatment items only).

requests.request_id: <int> Unique identifier for this treatment request.
requests.e_q: <int> Ideal number of time periods between consecutive treatments in this request.
requests.e_minus: <int> Minimum allowed number of time periods between consecutive treatments in this request.
requests.e_plus: <int> Maximum allowed number of time periods between consecutive treatments in this request.
requests.f_q: <int> Time period of the last treatment before the planning horizon for this request.
requests.n_q: <int> Number of treatments for this request that fall within the planning horizon.
requests.f_q_prime: <int> Time period of the first treatment after the planning horizon for this request.
requests.treatment_item_ids: <list[int], length n_q> Ordered list of item identifiers for each treatment in this request.
requests.treatment_weights: <list[int], length n_q> Weight of each treatment item in this request, in the same order as treatment_item_ids.

arcs.from: <int> Item identifier at the tail of this timing arc.
arcs.to: <int> Item identifier at the head of this timing arc.
arcs.lag: <int> Minimum number of time periods by which the head item's assigned period must exceed the tail item's assigned period.
